title: Spec: agent callable uses initial_message not message
description:
## Problem
`SPECIFICATION.md` documents calling an agent with `{message = "..."}`, but the implementation expects `{initial_message = "..."}`.

| Spec (Wrong) | Reality (Correct) |
| --- | --- |
| `worker({message = "..."})` | `worker({initial_message = "..."})` |

## Why it matters
- Users following the spec will pass a parameter that is ignored, leading to confusing behavior.

## Where this shows up
- `TECHNICAL_DEBT.md` → “Agent Callable Parameter Name” (Category 1).
- `SPECIFICATION.md` around the agent callable examples (currently near line 2235).

## Proposed fix (docs-only)
- Update agent invocation examples to use `initial_message`.
- If `message` is intentionally supported as an alias, document both and clarify precedence.

## Acceptance criteria
- `SPECIFICATION.md` uses `initial_message` in the canonical agent call example(s).
- Any mention of `message` is removed or explicitly documented as an alias (if supported).
